changes: Added a hint under the developer key fields listing which keys are still missing, so entering a single key makes it clear all four are required at the same time
Anchored post-interactive startup warmups to process launch so conversations, tasks, and memories load immediately when the main UI appears long after launch (e.g. right after onboarding)
Improved settings accessibility and made skill and keyword filtering more reliable
Fixed recurring tasks repeatedly re-triggering background agent investigations every minute
Optimized Rewind capture policy with per-app heartbeat profiles, preview similarity skip, lazy JPEG encoding for assistants, and screen lock/sleep pause handling
Fixed the first chat message hanging when Claude sign-in had expired: it now fails fast and prompts you to reconnect instead of waiting on the sign-in window
Improved onboarding navigation, permission guidance, voice setup, and Gmail and Calendar connections.
Fixed desktop recordings that could stay active while USB or built-in microphones delivered no audio.
Clarified that the onboarding language picker controls how Omi listens and replies
Fixed locally saved memories reappearing after deletion
Made meeting-only recording the default onboarding choice and clarified the capture options
Fixed onboarding permission detection and restored local file scanning and profile memories
Fixed the onboarding push-to-talk demo waveform and preserved Floating Bar settings after the demo.
Fixed text chat hanging forever when personal pi packages request unavailable headless UI dialogs
Fixed desktop navigation, settings, and onboarding layouts so controls stay usable on compact screens.
Added standard mouse drag selection for completed chat messages
Improved macOS settings controls with consistent provider, account, and plan selection styling
